name: Doinaka Girls Utopia
original_name: どいなかガールズゆーとぴあ
source:
[i]"A gloomy loser like me was never going to get a girlfriend... I'm destined to spend the rest of my life alone." [/i]

After losing the brutal battle for love in the big city and nursing a broken heart, [b]Katase Shuuji[/b] decides to leave it all behind and move in with his grandmother in the countryside.
He just wants to take life slow, surrounded by nature...
(Though, if he could finally get a girlfriend, that'd be even better!)

Upon arriving in his sleepy new hometown, Shuuji is enthusiastically welcomed by [b]Aikawa Chinatsu[/b], an innocent country beauty who secretly feels self-conscious about rural life.

[i]"Y-You're... from the city, aren't you!? [/i]
[i]I'll show you around! It's only natural—I'm a local, after all!" [/i]

As it turns out, the village has been shrinking for years, and there are practically no young men left.

[b]Wait... does that mean being a young guy alone makes me popular here...? [/b]

Before long, Chinatsu's friends—[b]Kirino Ririka[/b] and [b]Nanahara Amane[/b]—join the picture.

[i]"So you're that guy from the city? Hm... Honestly? You don't look like much." [/i]
[i]"Come on, Ririka... You know, the moment she heard a boy was finally coming to town, she got all dressed up and rushed over." [/i]

Pure-hearted, sheltered, and far too easy to fluster, the girls can't hide their curiosity—or the unmistakable affection in their eyes for Shuuji.

[i]"S-Shuuji-kun... do you have a girlfriend?" [/i]

Can a gloomy, socially awkward virgin whose "time without a girlfriend" equals his age really turn his life around just by moving to the countryside!?

As one breathtaking, busty beauty after another falls head over heels for him, Shuuji discovers that the quiet backwoods might just be the [b]utopia[/b] he'd always dreamed of.

[Translated from the [url=https://app.candysoft.jp/products/dessertsoft/utopia/story/]official website[/url]]
translation:
[i]“像我这种阴沉废柴根本不可能交到女朋友……这辈子注定要孤独终老了。”[/i]

在大都市残酷的恋爱战场上败下阵来、带着一颗破碎之心黯然神伤的[b]片濑修司[/b]，决定抛下城里的一切，搬去乡下投奔外祖母同住。
他只想在大自然的环抱中过上悠闲慢节奏的日子……
（当然啦，要是能顺便交到梦寐以求的女朋友那就更完美了！）

刚抵达这座宁静冷清的新故乡，修司便受到了[b]逢川千夏[/b]的热情迎接——这位纯真善良的乡下美少女，心底其实对农村生活暗藏着几分自卑。

[i]“你、你是……从大城市搬来的吧！？[/i]
[i]就由我带你到处逛逛吧！这可是理所当然的——毕竟我是本地人嘛！”[/i]

原来，这座村子多年来人口不断流失，村里几乎已经没有年轻男人留下来了。

[b]等等……这岂不是意味着，光是身为年轻男生这一点，就能让我在这里变成香饽饽……？[/b]

没过多久，千夏的好友——[b]雾乃莉莉香[/b]与[b]七七原天音[/b]——也相继登场。

[i]“你就是那个从城里来的家伙？唔……老实说，长得也就平平无奇嘛。”[/i]
[i]“好啦莉莉香……我跟你说哦，她一听说村里终于要来男孩子了，立马精心打扮了一番火急火燎赶过来了呢。”[/i]

心地纯洁、不谙世事又极易害羞脸红的少女们，根本藏不住自己对修司的强烈好奇——以及眼眸中流露出的满满好感。

[i]“修、修司君……你有女朋友吗？”[/i]

一个“母胎单身年数等于实际年龄”、阴沉怕生的社交障碍处男，难道光靠搬去乡下就能彻底逆袭人生吗！？

随着一位又一位美艳动人的巨乳美少女接连对他芳心暗许，修司惊讶地发现：这片宁静偏僻的穷乡僻壤，说不定正是他一直梦寐以求的[b]理想乡[/b]。

[译自[url=https://app.candysoft.jp/products/dessertsoft/utopia/story/]官方网站[/url]]
